source:
@@U03364@@
Their pride overweening!
Kill them, slay them,
All together,
So each of our helmets
Can boast its own feather!

@@U03366@@
Iron we bring them—
Ah, who is to save us!—
Which into harsh chains
They forge to enslave us.
The time’s not yet come
To rise in defiance;
So bow to your tyrants
In lowly compliance.

@@U03368@@
Shrieks of murder, dying groans,
Wings that flutter in dismay,
Ah, what outcry and what moans
To us in flight here pierce their way!
They are all already dead,
The placid lake with blood is red.
Reckless passion for display
Raped the heron’s plumes away.
Behold their helmets! See it wave
On each bowlegged paunchy knave!
You companions of our host,
Wedge-shaped wanderers of our coast,
Hear our cry, on you we call
For vengeance that affects us all.
Death, so we avenge their fate!
To this rabble deathless hate!

@@U03369@@
(They scatter, screeching, in the air.)

@@U03371@@
(On the plain.)

@@U03372@@
I’ve always known how to master Nordic witches;
it’s these foreign types I just can't get the knack of.
HAUS RARE sawi@! 8 O21
translation:
@@U03364@@
他们的骄傲自大！
杀了他们，杀了他们，
所有人在一起，
所以我们每个头盔
可以夸耀自己的羽毛！

@@U03366@@
我们给他们带来了铁——
啊，谁来救救我们啊！——
进入严酷的链条
他们锻造是为了奴役我们。
时间还没到
奋起反抗；
所以向你们的暴君低头吧
合规性较低。

@@U03368@@
谋杀的尖叫声，垂死的呻吟声，
翅膀因沮丧而扑腾，
啊，什么叫喊和什么呻吟
向我们这里的飞行者刺穿他们的道路！
他们都已经死了，
平静的湖水被血染红了。
不计后果的展示热情
强夺了苍鹭的羽毛。
看看他们的头盔！看它波
在每一个罗圈腿、大腹便便的无赖身上！
各位东道主的同伴们，
我们海岸的楔形流浪者，
聆听我们的呼喊，我们呼唤你
为了影响我们所有人的复仇。
死亡，让我们为命运报仇！
对这乌合之众有不死之恨！

@@U03369@@
（它们尖叫着在空中四散开来。）

@@U03371@@
（在平原上。）

@@U03372@@
我一直知道如何征服北欧女巫；
这些是我无法掌握的外国类型。
罕见的HAUS SAWI@！ 8 O21
